$comment: Canonical key set for ONE row of `fno agents list --json`. Two serializers produce this shape and they have drifted before (the Rust one stayed pinned to the pre-v10 keys and dropped harness, harness_session_id and mux for every live row, so operators and agents read a fully bound pane worker as unhosted and unidentified). Both are asserted against this file: cli/src/fno/agents/format.py::serialize_entry and the `agent.list` projection in crates/fno-agents/src/daemon.rs. Adding or removing a key means editing this file first; a serializer that disagrees fails its own test.

deprecated.provider: Legacy alias of `harness`, still emitted for consumers that predate the harness-as-sole-identity-axis rename. Read `harness`.

rust_only.$comment: Keys the Rust daemon projection emits on top of `required`. A harmless superset: the Python list surface has no equivalent source field.

python_only.$comment: Keys the Python serializer emits on top of `required`. Empty today.
